title: Deliver
headline: *Deliver*
sub: Send an order with a rider, and see where it is.

recap.en: Chiamaka's Nova X5 is packed. It has to reach her today.
recap.pcm: Chiamaka Nova X5 don pack. E must reach her today.

bridge.en: Delivered. Techline is getting busy, and Ikenna cannot stand at the counter all day.
bridge.pcm: E don reach. Techline dey busy and Ikenna no fit stand for counter all day.

flow.action: Rides up to the shop door on a small dark-pine motorcycle, takes the small bag from Ikenna's hands and straps it into his cool box with a two-finger salute
flow.setting: the doorway of Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja, a busy lane behind, mid-day sun
flow.camera: tracking shot beside the bike, eye-level

flow.action: Opens her flat door, sees the small bag, and puts both hands to her cheeks with delight
flow.setting: a small living room in a flat on Allen Avenue, Ikeja: a sofa, a work bag by the door, a bright window

en: Emeka is free, and covers Ikeja.
Later, the Orders tab lists the order.
He picks it up. On the way.
Delivered, paid in cash at the door.
pcm: Emeka free, and e dey cover Ikeja.
Later, the Orders tab go list the order.
E pick am up. E dey road.
E don deliver, dem pay cash for door.
